answer: During a registration tide, the required bond rises, pushing attackers toward their cost nadir only when honest participation dominates. Sybil resistance can use a proof-of-stake gate at the network inlet: each new agent reputation slot must lock a bond that scales with recent activity. Fake identities therefore burn real capital faster than they earn rewards, making mass account creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
